content: We need number of aromatic carbons in the sample's molecule. We have no description of molecule. We can get carbon NMR spectra to infer aromatic carbons? Could also get HSQC. But we need count of aromatic carbons. Likely the carbon NMR will show signals in aromatic region (~120-150 ppm). We can retrieve carbon NMR spectra using carbon_nmr_spectra tool. Then count peaks in aromatic region. Let's do that.
